core_obligations: Set up the homotopy argument (proof lines 3435-3455): work in the homotopy category K(Mod(O)), where the existence of a factorisation of a through a K-flat complex is a statement about the cone of the map, and use the long exact sequence of homotopy classes for the relevant distinguished triangle.

Construct the factorisation (proof lines 3455-3465): produce a K-flat complex N^bullet, a map b : K^bullet -> N^bullet and a quasi-isomorphism c : N^bullet -> L^bullet with a homotopic to c composed with b, which gives the first three clauses of the statement.

Preserve flatness of the terms (proof lines 3465-3481): when the terms of K^bullet are flat, the construction is refined so that the terms of N^bullet are flat as well, which is the last clause of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Translate the factorisation problem into the homotopy category and use the distinguished triangle attached to the map.
Construct a K-flat complex and a quasi-isomorphism through which the given map factors up to homotopy.
Refine the construction, using the flatness of the terms of K^bullet, so that the auxiliary complex has flat terms too.
difficulty_reason: The lemma factors a map a : K^bullet -> L^bullet out of a K-flat complex through a K-flat complex N^bullet with a quasi-isomorphism c : N^bullet -> L^bullet and with a homotopic to c composed with b, and it asks in addition that flatness of the terms be preserved (statement lines 3417-3433). The proof works in the homotopy category, where the factorisation is a statement about the distinguished triangle attached to the map and the long exact sequence of homotopy classes (proof lines 3435-3455); it then constructs the auxiliary complex and the maps (proof lines 3455-3465) and refines the construction so that flatness of the terms is inherited (proof lines 3465-3481). The non-formal content is the refinement in the flat case. The claim is H2: a homotopy-theoretic construction with one refinement, both written out.
